records.statement: theorem bent_iff_flat (f : Nat → Bool) : H12Descent.BentAC f ↔ WalshFlat f

theorem computed_filter_necessary (c : BitVec 43)
    (hb : H12Descent.BentAC (H12.quarticFunction c)) (j : Fin 43) :
    evaluate 43 c.getLsbD (rowPolynomial (points supports[j.val]!) originalRows) = false

theorem bent_passes (c : BitVec 43)
    (hb : H12Descent.BentAC (H12.quarticFunction c)) : H12Quadratic.Passes c
theorem necessary_r1 (c : BitVec 43) (h : Passes c) : r1 c = false
theorem necessary_r2 (c : BitVec 43) (h : Passes c) : r2 c = false
theorem necessary_r3 (c : BitVec 43) (h : Passes c) : r3 c = false

theorem short_product_zero (c : BitVec 43) (h : Passes c) :
    (c.getLsbD 40 && c.getLsbD 42) = false

theorem periodic_reduction (c : BitVec 43)
    (h : admissibleMod3 (parameters c).toNat) :
    restrictionTable c = 0x6ca0 ∨ restrictionTable c = 0x7ee8 ∨
    restrictionTable c = 0x8000 ∨ restrictionTable c = 0x9668

theorem quartic_bent_four_cases (c : BitVec 43)
    (hb : H12Descent.BentAC (H12.quarticFunction c)) :
    H12.restrictionTable c = 0x6ca0 ∨ H12.restrictionTable c = 0x7ee8 ∨
    H12.restrictionTable c = 0x8000 ∨ H12.restrictionTable c = 0x9668

theorem three_case_parameters (c : BitVec 43)
    (hp : H12Quadratic.Passes c)
    (hm : H12.admissibleMod3 (H12.parameters c).toNat) :
    (H12.parameters c).toNat = 2 ∨ (H12.parameters c).toNat = 3 ∨
      (H12.parameters c).toNat = 8

theorem necessary_chart_constraints (c : BitVec 43)
    (hb : H12Descent.BentAC (H12.quarticFunction c)) :
    ((H12.parameters c).toNat = 2 ∨ (H12.parameters c).toNat = 3 ∨
      (H12.parameters c).toNat = 8) ∧
    H12Quadratic.r1 c = false ∧ H12Quadratic.r2 c = false ∧ H12Quadratic.r3 c = false

theorem covers_bent (c : BitVec 43) (hb : H12Descent.BentAC (H12.quarticFunction c)) :
    ∃ k : Fin 3, embed k.val (project c) = c

theorem bent_root (c : BitVec 43) (hb : H12Descent.BentAC (H12.quarticFunction c)) :
    ∃ k : Fin 3, ∃ u : BitVec 36,
      H12Affine.embed k.val u = c ∧ Models 36 u.getLsbD targets[k.val]!

theorem refutes_sound (target : List Bool → Prop) (rootPS rootObs env : List Nat)
    (proof : Refutes target rootPS rootObs env) :
    ∀ f, packedModels (assignment env f) rootPS → ¬target (packedObservation (assignment env f) rootObs)
